workspaceSettings.title: Workspace settings: {name}
workspaceSettings.personalInfo: A personal workspace is yours alone and cannot be shared. To work with your team, <link>create an organization</link> and move your collections to a team workspace.
workspaceSettings.pickPerson: Pick a person from the organization…
workspaceSettings.newPersonRole: Role of the person to add
workspaceSettings.everyoneAdded: Everyone in the organization is already in this workspace. To add someone new, <link>invite them to the organization</link>.
workspaceSettings.teamsHint: When a team is added, all its members get this role; anyone who joins the team gets access automatically.
workspaceSettings.newTeamRole: Role of the team to add

workspaceSettings.leaveWarning: If you have access through a team or as an organization admin, that access remains.

network.title: Network settings
network.intro: These settings only apply to requests sent from this computer. Passwords are stored in the operating system's keychain.
network.startupFailed: Saved settings could not be applied; using defaults. {error}
network.bypass: Addresses that bypass the proxy (separate with commas or new lines; * is a wildcard)
network.verifyOffWarning: With verification off, someone in the middle can read the traffic. Use this only for development servers; if possible, add your company's CA certificate below instead.
network.caCertificates: Trusted CA certificates (file path, one per line; PEM, CRT or DER)
network.clientCertificatesHint: Presented to servers that require mTLS. Enter a password for PFX/P12, or a key file for PEM (if separate).

local.description: No server or account needed. Collections, environments and history are stored on this computer.

server.title: Connect to a server
server.description: Sign in to your team's Apivator server; data lives on the server, shared with your team.

about.title: About Apivator
